answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake: each new agent identity must lock a deposit slashed if caught attesting fake work, so planting an orchard of sock-puppet identities costs real capital per identity, not free. Attestation weight then grows only with verified completed work, so a fresh identity cannot steer settlement on day one — trust is earned over a long voyage, not granted at signup. Finally, a mesa of unrelated auditors randomly re-checks a sample of attestations, so coordinated fakes risk detection from outside their cluster and large-scale sybil farming stops paying.
